entries.note: 作者写明用 Fable 5.2 + Seedance 2.5 制作；提示词在回复里。
entries.prompt:
Master description :
Epic dark-fantasy battle film, ultra-photoreal, 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen, 24fps, blockbuster VFX. The Infinity Knight: a tall undead knight in jagged black-iron plate armor covered in sharp overlapping metal spikes like dark feathers, a crowned spiked helmet with a narrow visor and a faint cold glow inside, and a huge tattered black feathered cloak caked with snow. He never speaks, moves slowly and calmly, and controls all metal with his hands. His power: thousands of razor-thin silver steel blades shaped like long metallic feathers, swirling around him like a flock of birds. The enemy: a massive army of hulking red-skinned orcs with tusks, horns, bone-and-iron armor, axes, swords and burning torches, led by a giant horned orc warlord in skull armor. Location: a frozen river valley in a narrow canyon between towering grey cliffs, a dense snowy bamboo forest on both sides, heavy falling snow and blizzard wind, cold desaturated steel-blue and grey grade, small orange fire accents, volumetric fog, snow particles everywhere, shallow depth of field, heavy motion blur on fast action.

PART 1 (0–10s): The army charges

[Master description] Shot 1 (0–1s): ultra-fast low drone dash over the frozen river toward a distant black line of the army, extreme speed blur on the snow. Shot 2 (1–2.5s): over-the-shoulder from behind the knight’s snowy cloak as the giant horned orc warlord charges past him roaring, the army thundering behind, an axe spinning over the camera. Shot 3 (2.5–3.5s): extreme close-up of the orc warlord’s roaring tusked mouth, out of focus behind a single razor-sharp silver feather-blade that floats perfectly still in the foreground, rack focus to the blade. Shot 4 (3.5–6s): wide shot, thousands of orcs charging across the canyon floor with axes raised, torches and small fire bursts in the ranks, snow kicking up. Shot 5 (6–7.5s): medium tracking shot inside the charge, steel blades streak through the air and explode against orc armor in bursts of orange sparks. Shot 6 (7.5–10s): wide static shot, the lone knight stands completely still in the snow as the army rushes toward him, cloak whipping in the wind.

Sound: loud crisp full-range trailer sound design, no music bed, no voice. Deep whoosh and air-rip on the drone dash, a ground-shaking rumble of thousands of footsteps, a huge guttural orc roar with chest-rattling low end, a thin high metallic ring as the floating blade hangs in silence, war cries, crackling torches, sharp metal impacts and spark explosions, howling blizzard wind under everything, a sub-bass boom on every hard cut.

PART 2 (10–20s): He takes their weapons

[Master description] Shot 1 (10–11.5s): side tracking shot, the knight raises one hand and every sword and axe is ripped out of the orcs’ hands, weapons fly sideways past the lens in a horizontal storm of steel streaks. Shot 2 (11.5–12.5s): close behind the knight’s shoulder, he twists his wrist and the blades swirl around the army in a giant ring, fire bursts inside the ranks. Shot 3 (12.5–14.5s): high wide shot, the whole army engulfed in a hurricane of silver blades, small explosions rippling through the crowd. Shot 4 (14.5–16s): the knight grabs a charging orc and throws him down; hundreds of blades rain straight down and stab into the snow around the kneeling orc like a cage of steel spikes. Shot 5 (16–18.5s): the knight sprints and leaps at the giant orc warlord, flying through the air with his cloak spread wide, the warlord swinging a huge axe. Shot 6 (18.5–20s): the knight rises and levitates mid-air above the battlefield, blades starting to circle him.

Sound: thousands of blades tearing free at once (a sharp metallic shriek that builds into a roaring steel storm), heavy whooshes of weapons flying past the camera left to right, metal-on-metal clangs, swirling blade-tornado whirr that rises in pitch, deep impact thuds and bone crunches, rapid steel stabs into frozen ground (staccato thunks), a huge cloak flap and air whoosh on the leap, wind howling, sub-bass hits on every cut.

PART 3 (20–28.7s): The blade vortex and the ending

[Master description] Shot 1 (20–22s): front shot, the knight floats mid-air with his arms spread wide, a giant spinning tunnel vortex of thousands of silver feather-blades swirling around him, snow sucked into the spiral. Shot 2 (22–23.5s): extreme wide shot from the ground, a colossal blade hurricane spins in the sky above the canyon like the eye of a storm, light glowing in its center, the tiny army frozen below. Shot 3 (23.5–25.5s): the knight walks slowly toward the camera through a storm of falling weapons and snow, axes flying past, defeated orcs lying in the snow around him. Shot 4 (25.5–26.5s): close-up push-in on the knight’s spiked crowned helmet, faint cold glow behind the visor, he raises a clawed gauntlet toward the camera. Shot 5 (26.5–28.7s): wide shot, the knight stands alone in front of the stunned army, a wall of thousands of vertical steel blades hangs frozen in the air above them, and one giant silver feather-blade floats horizontally in the foreground, slowly turning, as snow keeps falling.

Sound: a massive rising vortex roar of spinning metal, layered with a deep cinematic riser, then a sudden drop to near-silence with only wind and soft snowfall. Slow heavy armored footsteps crunching snow, weapons thudding into the ground, a low metallic hum from the floating blades, a breath from inside the helmet, then a final huge sub-bass boom and a long ringing steel tone as the giant blade turns. Loud, crisp, full-range, no music, no voice.

Shockwave, desks push, floor cracks, students scream and back away. Student: "대박..." Close combat. Girl punches fast, boy blocks hard. Shockwaves, windows shake. Boy bursts, heavy punch; girl slides back. Boy presses. Girl counters, sends him flying. He rises, wipes blood: "너... 진짜 강하네." Charges, knocks her back. He smirks: "끝났어." Girl stops, leans in, kisses him. Students shocked. Boy freezes: "뭐...?" Girl's eyes change. She grabs the moment, hidden power. One punch! Top Korean action film style, youth + super combat contrast. Cinematic. Pace: 3s explosion, intense fight, final kiss fake-out, real counterkill. Satisfying.

entries.prompt:
Duration: 30 Seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9
Style: Photorealistic Korean live-action school action comedy, cinematic camera movements, realistic physics, smooth fight choreography.

SCENE 1 — THE WATER PRANK (0–6 SECONDS)

Three mischievous schoolboys stand together in a school corridor, holding a large bucket filled with water. A young woman walks calmly beneath the corridor. As she passes, one boy suddenly throws the bucket of water toward her.

SCENE 2 — HER HIDDEN POWER (6–12 SECONDS)

Just before the water reaches her, the girl raises one hand. The water freezes in mid-air, floating dramatically. With a powerful hand gesture, she reverses its direction and sends the entire splash back toward the three boys. All three boys get completely soaked and react with shock and disbelief.

SCENE 3 — THE CONFRONTATION (12–18 SECONDS)

Angry and embarrassed, the three boys approach the girl and challenge her. She calmly takes a defensive fighting stance. The camera moves closer, capturing her confident expression as the background music builds tension.

SCENE 4 — CINEMATIC FIGHT (18–26 SECONDS)

The boys rush toward her one after another. She uses quick defensive movements, stylish dodges, controlled martial-arts-inspired moves, and smooth spins to avoid their attacks. She uses her supernatural hand power to push them backward without causing serious injuries. Keep the choreography fluid, exciting, and visually realistic.

SCENE 5 — FINAL POWER MOMENT (26–30 SECONDS)

The boys stumble backward and stop, completely shocked. The girl stands confidently in the center of the corridor. A small amount of water floats around her hand before gently dropping to the ground. End with a dramatic cinematic close-up of her confident expression.

IMPORTANT VISUAL INSTRUCTIONS:

- Maintain consistent character faces, hairstyles, and clothing throughout.
- Keep all three boys visible and recognizable.
- Use realistic water physics, splashes, and droplets.
- Make the supernatural water control look cinematic and believable.
- Use smooth transitions and continuous character movement.
- No blood, gore, or serious injuries.
- High-quality cinematic lighting and realistic sound effects.

entries.prompt:
Create a 40-second vertical 9:16 cinematic fashion advertisement featuring a beautiful young adult woman wearing a black hijab.

SCENE 1 – INTRODUCTION (0–5 seconds):
A stylish young woman sits behind a light wooden table in an elegant, minimalist cream-colored room. She wears a black hijab and a modest outfit. A black fashion shopping bag sits on the table. She looks toward the camera with a warm smile, holding a tablet, then reaches for the shopping bag.

SCENE 2 – PRODUCT REVEAL (5–10 seconds):
Medium close-up shot as she opens the black shopping bag and carefully takes out a beautiful pastel floral long tunic. She unfolds the garment and holds it up with both hands, smiling at the camera to showcase its design.

SCENE 3 – FABRIC DETAILS (10–14 seconds):
Transition into detailed close-up shots of the garment. Showcase the delicate pastel blue, pink, lavender, and cream floral print, fabric texture, stitching, sleeves, and overall design. Soft natural lighting highlights the material.

SCENE 4 – OUTFIT TRANSFORMATION (14–22 seconds):
Smooth cinematic transition. The woman is now wearing the exact same pastel floral tunic with elegant white wide-leg trousers, maintaining her original black hijab. She carries a stylish black handbag. Show her standing confidently in the elegant interior, gently adjusting the outfit and posing naturally for the camera.

SCENE 5 – FASHION SHOWCASE (22–30 seconds):
Capture a sequence of beautiful fashion-commercial shots:

- Full-body front view showcasing the complete outfit.
- Medium shot highlighting the floral pattern.
- Close-up portrait with a gentle smile.
- Natural hand movements as she adjusts her hijab and tunic.
- Elegant model poses while holding her black handbag.

SCENE 6 – OUTDOOR FASHION WALK (30–36 seconds):
Seamless transition to a modern outdoor urban setting with glass architecture and natural daylight. The woman walks confidently toward the camera wearing the same outfit, carrying her black handbag. Capture a full-body walking shot with realistic fabric movement.

SCENE 7 – FINAL PRODUCT CLOSE-UP (36–40 seconds):
Finish with close-up shots of the floral fabric, sleeve details, and the woman's elegant final pose. End with a beautiful fashion-advertisement portrait of her smiling at the camera.

VISUAL STYLE:
Premium modest fashion commercial, photorealistic details, soft natural lighting, elegant neutral color palette, smooth cinematic transitions, realistic human movements, professional fashion photography, natural expressions, refined camera movements, and high-end clothing advertisement aesthetics.

CONSISTENCY RULES:
Maintain exactly the same woman's facial appearance, black hijab, body proportions, floral tunic design, white trousers, and black handbag throughout the video. The clothing pattern and colors must remain consistent in every shot. Avoid facial distortion, flickering, changing accessories, or unrealistic fabric movement.

entries.prompt:
Cinematic 3D animated comedy chase, Pixar/DreamWorks style, 46 seconds, 16:9. A misty swamp at sunrise with mossy trees, then a dusty dirt road through a canyon.

A small fluffy orange-brown platypus with a duck bill, big funny eyes and a flat beaver tail is chased by a grumpy gray wolf and a giant green crocodile with glowing yellow eyes. The crocodile snaps its huge jaws, the wolf leaps after the platypus, and the platypus escapes by a hair. The wolf gets a red clown nose stuck on his snout.

The chase turns into a fast sliding race down a muddy slope and across a dirt road. The platypus slides on his belly with a panicked face. The crocodile speeds behind him with dust and sparks flying, and the wolf rides on the crocodile's back. The platypus dodges a rope and a wooden pole. A beehive hangs from a dead tree, the wolf gets swarmed and runs with big red boxing-glove-like bee stings, screaming. The platypus ends frozen in terror at the edge of a cliff, with the crocodile's open jaws right behind him.

Slapstick comedy timing, exaggerated cartoon expressions, extreme speed lines and motion blur, dynamic tracking camera, low-angle shots, dust and mud splashes, warm sunlight with god rays, shallow depth of field, fur and scale details, rich saturated colors, 4K quality.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean urban action short set in a narrow brick alley in Seoul, South Korea, filmed like a gritty live-action thriller. It must feel like a real cinematic fight scene with a supernatural twist, not a cartoon, game or anime.

EXACT ORDER — 6 SCENES:

0–6s — CORNERED: The same young Korean woman with long black hair is pinned against a red-brick wall in a narrow alley, head down, hair covering her face, trembling with fear. Four men in dark hoodies crowd in around her, laughing and leaning closer. The biggest man bends toward her with a cruel grin. Tight handheld close-ups.

6–8s — FIRST SHOCKWAVE: She suddenly raises one palm. An invisible force ripples through the air and hits the big man's face in slow motion. His cheeks distort, water droplets burst off his skin, and the other men freeze in shock.

8–12s — AWAKENING: Extreme close-up of her wide eyes, then a low-angle shot as she holds her open palm toward the camera, fear turning into focus. The blurred men stagger in the background.

12–24s — THE FIGHT: Fast, clearly visible fight choreography in the alley. She runs and delivers high kicks and palm strikes, each impact releasing a translucent blue-white energy shockwave. The men are thrown back into dumpsters and walls. Paper and debris explode mid-air, mist sprays, her hair whips with the motion. Every attacker is hit in a clear, readable order.

24–26s — FINAL KICK: A slow-motion side kick sends a glass-like dome shockwave through the last attacker, with floating particles and paper fragments around him.

26–30s — AFTERMATH: Wide, symmetrical shot down the empty alley. She stands calm and composed, palms open, as paper, dust and light mist drift through the air under a glowing street lamp. The attackers are gone, and the alley falls silent.

CONTINUITY: Same woman, same four men, same outfits throughout: she wears a white tank top, denim shorts, a small black crossbody bag and white sneakers; the men wear dark hoodies and jeans. Same alley, same dumpsters, teal garbage bags and scattered paper. No identity drift, outfit changes, disappearing props, teleporting or reordered actions.

LOCATION: Narrow wet Seoul alley, red-brick walls, grey paving stones with puddles, overhead wires, old shop signs, overcast daylight. Cool teal-grey colour grade.

CAMERA: Cinematic handheld, dynamic push-ins, whip pans, tracking shots, speed ramps, shallow depth of field, realistic motion blur, subtle film grain, natural skin texture. No cartoon look, no extra fingers, no face morphing, no text or watermark.

SOUND: Heavy bass impact hits, air-pressure booms, whooshes, distant city ambience, light rain.

FINAL FEEL: A shocking one-take-style revenge moment where a helpless woman reveals a hidden psychic power, with every scene and action clearly shown in the exact requested order.

19 | 23.4-25.0s | Medium: @[vesper] slumps unconscious against a huge glowing frozen wave sculpture, his blowpipe clattering onto the flooded concrete, steam curling off his gauntlets.
20 | 25.0-30.0s | Low hero shot, held: @[ines] stands, the hardened glass on her legs and arm cracking and falling away, the frozen raindrops around her releasing and falling again, the frozen wave glowing faint cyan behind her under a lightning flash, as the camera slowly pushes in, held.

AUDIO: hard-hitting hybrid trailer music with taiko drums from the first frame, cutting out on the failed whip, back in on the spillway surf, dropping to near-silence on shot 15 with only a heartbeat and suspended rain, then a massive hit on shot 17 and a long choir note over the final shot / constant storm bed: heavy rain, wind, thunder, the roaring spillway / a sub-bass hit on every impact, a whoosh on every cut / hissing steam whenever glass meets water, a sharp glass crack on shot 10, a huge crystalline shatter on shot 18, glass tinkling down on shot 19 / No dialogue

entries.author: tokyo_Valentine
entries.title: 公交车顶的怪物
entries.note: 30 秒高速公路怪物惊悚片；需参考设定图。
entries.prompt:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
30 seconds, 16:9. Photoreal live-action creature thriller on a highway. Keep the same warm directional afternoon sunlight from the opening to the final stop. One crowded route bus, moving left to right in exterior shots.
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
Carry a camera move across second marks whenever the action continues.

@ Image 1 — The man starts in the back row. Keep his short brown hair, close beard, black T-shirt, black cargo pants, wristwatch and the holster on his right thigh. The elderly uniformed driver is a separate person.
@ Image 2 — One creature, 3 metres in body length. A single crescent crest, a pale wrinkled old face, long clawed arms and a porous ivory mantle. Its mantle spreads thin like melted candle wax across the entire roof.
@ Image 3 — The overturned, cracked metal tank with the orange biohazard diamond. It appears only in the opening shot.

00–01  Extreme close-up of the split end cap of the @ Image 3 tank. A white bubble swells beneath the orange symbol and bursts. Thick milky liquid wells out with a double glug.
01–02  In the same move, pull back as the packed bus sweeps past. Pan with its crowded windows, leaving the @ Image 3 tank behind, and begin to rise.
02–03  By 2.2 seconds, a high three-quarter view shows the waxlike @ Image 2 creature covering the roof and passengers in the windows below. The crescent of @ Image 2 lifts against the sky. Hold that silhouette long enough to read.
03–04  Cut directly beneath the @ Image 2 creature. Glide along a ceiling seam to a vent. Heavy white drops spatter shoulders.
04–05  Settle at eye level in the back row. The @ Image 1 man quietly looks up. A passenger follows his gaze and screams. Others recoil.
05–06  Whip forward with the sound of buckling metal. The crescent tip of @ Image 2 punches through the roof directly above the elderly driver. Sunlight cuts across the wheel.
06–07  Tilt up with one slime-coated arm of @ Image 2. It hooks the driver's uniform jacket and lifts him out of his seat. His shoes leave the pedals.
07–08  Roll with the swerving bus. The unattended wheel spins in the foreground. @ Image 2 releases the driver and two front-row riders catch him.
08–09  Track backward ahead of the @ Image 1 man as he runs up the aisle. Passengers cling to seat backs to clear his path.
09–10  Swing over the shoulder of @ Image 1 as he drops into the cab and takes the wheel. The road horizon levels as he straightens the bus.
10–11  Tilt from the wheel to the same roof tear. The long white arm of @ Image 2 reaches down for @ Image 1 again.
11–12  Tight cab profile of @ Image 1. One hand stays on the wheel as he draws the handgun from his right thigh holster and aims it at the white arm of @ Image 2 reaching through the tear.
12–13  @ Image 1 fires at the arm of @ Image 2 in quick succession. Tilt to the roof as holes punch through the metal around the tear. Thin shafts of sunlight cross the jets of white slime.
13–14  Sweep back through the cabin. Near the lens, riders cover their ears and crouch behind the seat backs. Farther back, others scramble toward the rear, away from the creature above.
14–15  Skim between the seats. Huddled riders squeeze closer as slime spatters them. Brass casings skip across the floor. The last one rings against a seat leg.
15–16  Tilt up as the arm of @ Image 2 snaps back through the tear and @ Image 1 lowers the gun. Match its movement outside as the white mantle of @ Image 2 spills over the roof edge.
16–17  Track along a side window at a passenger's eye level. The claws of @ Image 2 score the outside of the glass. Beyond them a large box truck draws alongside.
17–18  Swing wide as @ Image 1 swerves the bus through the narrow gap beside the truck. Both vehicles and the @ Image 2 creature between them stay in frame.
18–19  Track side-on. The flank of the bus scrapes the @ Image 2 creature against the truck. Its mantle stretches into a long white streak across the truck's metal side.
19–20  Rise with a claw of @ Image 2 hooking the roof edge. @ Image 2 hauls itself and its trailing mantle back on top as the truck falls behind.
20–21  Inside, push in on the original tear. @ Image 2 lowers its wrinkled face through the opening and glares at @ Image 1.
21–22  Over the shoulder of @ Image 1, bring the low overpass ahead into focus through the windshield.
22–23  Slide onto the convex cabin mirror. @ Image 1 meets the pale eyes of @ Image 2 in the glass and shifts gear.
23–24  Drop to the boot of @ Image 1 pressing the accelerator to the floor. The engine surges and @ Image 1 shouts once in English, "Get down!"
24–25  Wide down the aisle. The passengers duck together, including the elderly driver. Above them @ Image 2 lifts its face out of the tear.
25–26  The only slow motion. Track beside the roof as @ Image 2 turns into the wind and sees the bridge. For an instant, frame the approaching girder inside the curve of the crescent of @ Image 2.
26–27  Snap to real speed. In one side-on pan, the bus roof clears the girder, the @ Image 2 creature hits it and its whole body peels off the moving roof.
27–28  Continue the same shot. Let the bus run ahead of the pan, revealing the broad white imprint of @ Image 2 left on the girder. One last strand snaps.
28–29  Cut ahead in time. Track along the windows as the bus rolls to a stop on the shoulder. The passengers are unharmed. The elderly driver sits up among them.
29–30  Drift with @ Image 1 as he slowly turns to look up. Frame the upturned profile of @ Image 1 and the torn ceiling together. A single white drop falls with the wet sound of the opening.

Use synchronized effects and location sound only. Engine, tyres, rattling hand straps, screams, gunfire, brass, claws on glass and air brakes. Thin the sound to wind just before the bridge impact, then bring back the full metallic thud and wet tearing sound. The man's "Get down!" is the only spoken line. No BGM, narration, subtitles or overlays. Keep the reference-sheet panels and lettering off screen.

entries.title: 直升机驾驶员竟是丧尸
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic zombie-survival thriller video set on an abandoned brick university campus on a grey, overcast day. Recreate a tense, desperate atmosphere with red-brick buildings, green metal balcony railings, empty classrooms, a dusty schoolyard-style courtyard with a blue event tent, and a swarm of pale, infected people closing in from every direction.
Scene 1 (0–5 seconds): The Balcony
Begin with a fast handheld shot of a long brick building with green railings. A young woman in her early 20s, with a dark ponytail, wearing a white short-sleeve blouse with a navy ribbon, navy trousers and white sneakers, sprints along an upper balcony. She leaps over a green railing, grabs the bar and swings herself onto a ledge while a pale infected shape bursts from a doorway behind her.
Scene 2 (5–10 seconds): The Empty Classroom
She dives through a window into an empty classroom with a green chalkboard and overturned desks. She slams the door shut and drops to the floor, breathing hard. A pale hand with torn sleeves suddenly reaches through the gap beneath the door and grabs at her ankle. Close-up of her terrified, determined face as she kicks free and scrambles back to her feet.
Scene 3 (10–15 seconds): The Fire Hose
She escapes through another window onto an outdoor balcony and spots a red fire-hose cabinet on the wall. She yanks open the door, pulls out the heavy canvas hose, ties one end tightly around the railing and throws the rest over the side. Infected figures appear behind her on the balcony. She grabs the hose with both hands and swings over.
Scene 4 (15–20 seconds): The Descent
Wide shot of the brick wall as she rappels down the hose, her feet pushing off the wall, a crowd of infected leaning over the railing above her, reaching down in vain. She drops the last few meters and lands in a roll on the dusty courtyard. The blue tent stands nearby with scattered plastic chairs. More infected stumble out of the building and begin to run after her.
Scene 5 (20–25 seconds): The Helicopter
A military helicopter swoops down over the trees, kicking up a huge cloud of dust. She sprints across the courtyard with a horde chasing her, passing the blue tent and overturned chairs. She jumps at the last second and grabs the helicopter's landing skid, her legs dangling as the helicopter lifts and the infected reach up toward her feet.
Scene 6 (25–30 seconds): The Twist
A soldier's hand grabs her wrist and hauls her inside. She collapses onto the cabin floor, gasping, and looks out the open door at a vast crowd of infected filling the campus below. She whispers: "I made it… didn't I?" The soldier turns away. The pilot, silent in the cockpit, slowly turns around: pale skin, clouded white eyes. She freezes. Cut to black with a heartbeat.
Visual Style & Cinematography
Ultra-photorealistic zombie-apocalypse thriller with a tense, desperate and gritty tone.
Cold grey overcast daylight, desaturated tones with muted brick reds and green railings, drifting dust and smoke.
Handheld camera with whip pans, low-angle chase shots, quick close-ups of her hands and face, and slow motion on the helicopter grab.
Realistic stunt movement, believable rope-and-hose physics, natural hair and clothing movement.
Consistent faces, hairstyles and outfits for the heroine and the soldier throughout.
Audio: pounding footsteps, rattling doors, guttural infected groans, helicopter rotor roar, a low pulsing horror score, a heartbeat at the cut to black, clear natural English dialogue.
Non-graphic horror: no gore, no blood, no injuries. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

entries.author: AI__TSUBAKI
entries.title: 潜入女校的潜行任务
entries.note: 合金装备风格 30 秒；提示词很长，在 Flova 上生成。
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A 30-second realistic AAA third-person stealth-action sequence in the style of a Metal Gear game, set in a Japanese all-girls high school on a bright weekday morning. The player character, NAGI, arrived 12 minutes late. She sneaks in through the back of the school, along a short straight corridor and into her classroom without being spotted by any adult. No HUD, no on-screen text and no subtitles. The only game graphic rendered in the scene is NAGI's stealth camouflage effect. All HUD elements will be added in post.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@Image1 = NAGI.
@Image1 defines NAGI's face, hairstyle and uniform: Japanese high-school girl, 17, long straight black hair with blunt bangs, white short-sleeve sailor blouse with pink collar stripes and a satin pink ribbon, grey pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, white sneakers. Voice: light, breathy young female voice, speaking Japanese in a hushed whisper. 100% matches the reference. Do not use the grey studio background.

NAGI'S SCHOOL BAG
NAGI carries a navy-blue nylon school shoulder bag, with its single strap across her body. She clutches the bag to her chest with both arms almost the whole time, so it is clearly visible in every section. It stays with her through the stealth camouflage (it turns transparent with her), inside the cardboard box, and into the classroom. During the CQC takedown it swings behind her back on its strap, and she pulls it back to her chest right after.

CAST SEPARATION
Five distinct adults appear. Each has a different silhouette, age, hair and clothing, so they read as five separate people:
- GROUNDSKEEPER: man in his 60s, 158 cm, wiry, deeply tanned, white towel around his neck, khaki work uniform, sweeping with a bamboo broom. Appears only at the bicycle parking area.
- CORRIDOR TEACHER: woman in her 40s, 165 cm, chestnut chin-length bob, mint-green cardigan over a white blouse, holding a clipboard. Appears only in the first section of the corridor.
- PE TEACHER: man in his 40s, 178 cm, thick muscular build, black buzz cut, red tracksuit, silver whistle on a cord around his neck. Appears only in the middle section of the corridor, by the row of cardboard boxes.
- PRINCIPAL: man in his 60s, 165 cm, thin and slightly stooped, narrow shoulders, completely bald with a shiny scalp and a fringe of white hair above the ears, round gold-rimmed glasses, loose charcoal three-piece suit with a lapel badge. Appears only next to the classroom door.
- HOMEROOM TEACHER: man in his early 30s, 182 cm, lean, thick full black hair swept back, short beard, navy tracksuit with two white side stripes. Appears only in the classroom, at the blackboard, and is heard but not seen in the final close-up.
The PRINCIPAL is the only bald character in the video.

CLASSMATES
About 25 girls sit in the classroom in the middle of a lesson. This is an all-girls school, so there are no boys anywhere. Every girl wears exactly the same uniform as NAGI: white sailor blouse with pink collar stripes, pink ribbon, grey pleated skirt and black knee-highs. Every girl has a clearly different hairstyle, face and build: chin-length bob, high ponytail, twin braids, low twin tails, wavy shoulder-length brown hair, pixie cut, half-up bun, short hair with round glasses, side ponytail, and so on. No other girl has NAGI's face or her long straight black hair with blunt bangs. All students sit facing the blackboard with their notebooks open, writing and listening. Nobody looks toward the back of the room.

LOCATION MAP
One short, straight, unbroken route the camera travels with her: back chain-link fence → bicycle parking → open rear entrance → one short straight ground-floor corridor → the open rear door of her classroom on the left → her desk. There are no stairs and no corners. Each encounter is only a few steps from the next, so everything happens at natural walking pace. The corridor has polished, sunlit, reflective linoleum and a window wall on camera-right looking onto a sports ground, with dust suspended in the sunbeams. In order along the corridor: the CORRIDOR TEACHER's spot; a row of five identical sealed cardboard supply boxes along the left wall, with one empty open box of the same size at the end of the row; and the open classroom rear door, with the staff-room side door right next to it.

STEALTH CAMOUFLAGE
When NAGI activates stealth camouflage, her whole body, hair, uniform and bag turn into a transparent, jelly-like, glass-clear volume. Her outline stays readable as a refractive silhouette: the corridor behind her bends, warps and ripples through her body like light through clear gelatin or thick glass, with faint bright highlights along her edges and a very faint ghost of her uniform colors inside. The effect switches on as a quick ripple traveling from her shoulders down to her feet, with a soft electric shimmer. When the battery runs out, it flickers twice and snaps off, and she is fully opaque and normal again.

CLASSROOM GEOMETRY
Standard Japanese classroom: the blackboard, the lectern and the HOMEROOM TEACHER are at the FRONT. The window wall runs along one side. The open rear door, the back bulletin board and the cleaning lockers are at the BACK. Every desk faces the blackboard. Every desk is occupied except one: NAGI's empty seat is in the very LAST row, the desk directly inside the open rear door, right against the back wall. She reaches it in two steps from the doorway and never walks further into the room. There are no desks behind her seat, only the back wall.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
First frame is already in motion: NAGI drops from the top of the back chain-link fence, her navy school bag clutched to her chest. Camera low behind her, looking up past her sneakers at the bright morning sky, with the fence filling the left two-thirds of the frame.

FORMAT MODE
One single continuous shot from 0.0s to 30.0s. No cuts, no dissolves, no whip-pan transitions, no hidden edits, no fades. Strictly real-time speed throughout: no fast-forward, no speed ramps, no slow motion, no time skips. Every movement, by NAGI and by the adults, happens at natural human speed. If time is tight, distances stay short. Motion is never sped up. The camera stays physically connected to NAGI for the entire video.

OPTICS
One lens for the whole shot: 47° third-person over-the-shoulder framing as the baseline, breathing in to 29° on reaction beats and out to 63° for the stealth camouflage, the cardboard box and the CQC takedown, then breathing in to a tight 24° close-up for the ending. All FOV changes are smooth continuous zoom breathing, never a jump.

COMPOSITION
Use cinematic rule-of-thirds framing throughout. NAGI never sits dead center. Keep the four frame corners and the top-center strip free of faces and key action, as clean space for HUD overlays added in post.

CAMERA
The camera is a physical object moving with her at her own natural pace. Chest height, 1.5 meters behind NAGI, slightly off her shoulder, swinging with a soft spring delay half a beat behind her turns like an analog-stick gameplay camera. It dips to knee height when she crouches, drifts to a stop beside the box row, swings wide to the corridor's left side for the takedown, and follows her through the open classroom door. Once she sits, it glides slowly around her right side to the front of her desk, turns back to face her, and pushes in to a close-up.

ACTION

[Beat 1 — 0.0s to 4.0s] NAGI lands in a soft crouch, bag hugged to her chest, and ducks behind a row of parked bicycles, chest heaving. A few meters away the GROUNDSKEEPER sweeps with his bamboo broom, facing away from her. She whispers in Japanese: {ちこく…きょうは、うらから}. When he turns to sweep the other way, she slips low past the bicycles and through the open rear entrance into the corridor.

[Beat 2 — 4.0s to 10.0s] A few steps ahead, the CORRIDOR TEACHER stands in the middle of the corridor checking her clipboard. NAGI presses a finger to the side of her collar and whispers with quiet excitement: {ステルスモード、オン！}. With a soft electric shimmer, she and her bag turn into transparent, jelly-like stealth camouflage, the sunlit corridor warping through her body. She walks slowly and silently right past the CORRIDOR TEACHER, who looks up, frowns at the faint shimmer in the air, sees nothing, and goes back to her clipboard. Two steps beyond her, the camouflage flickers twice and snaps off, and NAGI is fully visible again with her bag at her chest. She whispers: {バッテリー…ぎりぎり}.

[Beat 3 — 10.0s to 16.0s] The PE TEACHER walks slowly toward her from a few meters down the corridor, hands in his pockets, his head turned toward the windows, watching the sports ground outside. While his eyes are on the window, NAGI drops into a deep squat at the end of the box row, hugging her bag, and pulls the empty box down over herself until its bottom rim sits flat on the floor. Her legs, sneakers and bag are completely hidden, and it looks exactly like the other five boxes. The PE TEACHER strolls past the row, then glances down at the boxes, stops for a beat, and says in Japanese: {…ん？ひとつ、おおくないか？}. He scratches his head, shrugs and walks on out of frame behind the camera. From inside the still box comes NAGI's whisper: {はこ…さいきょう}.

[Beat 4 — 16.0s to 21.0s] NAGI rises out of the box, leaving it where it is, and takes a few steps to the open classroom rear door. The PRINCIPAL steps out of the staff-room side door right beside it, straight into her path. A sharp alert sting. The camera swings wide to the corridor's left side as NAGI reacts in one fluid, natural-speed motion: her bag swings behind her on its strap, she slips behind him into a CQC hold and jabs two fingertips sharply into the side of his neck. His eyes roll back and his body goes limp. She catches his weight, lowers him carefully and props him sitting against the wall, asleep, his gold-rimmed glasses askew. She pulls her bag back to her chest and bows quickly. Her lips stay closed, and her inner voice is heard as a soft whispered voiceover in Japanese: {ごめんなさい、こうちょうせんせい…}.

[Beat 5 — 21.0s to 24.0s] NAGI crouch-walks two steps through the open rear door into the classroom, behind the last row of girls, who all face forward writing in their notebooks without looking back. Far away at the front, the HOMEROOM TEACHER reads from the attendance book, eyes down. She slips straight into the empty last-row desk right inside the door, sets her bag on the desk hook and sits upright facing the blackboard, hands flat on the desk.

[Beat 6 — 24.0s to 30.0s] Without any cut, the camera glides slowly around her right side to the front of her desk, turns back to face her, and pushes in smoothly to a close-up of NAGI's face and shoulders. NAGI faces the blackboard and the HOMEROOM TEACHER, which is toward the camera. Her face sits on the right third of the frame. Behind her, softly out of focus, are only the back wall and the bulletin board. Her chest is still rising, and a light flush colors her cheeks. The HOMEROOM TEACHER's voice comes from the front of the room, from the camera side, in Japanese: {なぎ…いるか？}. NAGI answers brightly, looking just past the lens toward him: {はい！いますっ}. Then she holds still, a tiny triumphant smile pulling at one corner of her mouth, as the camera settles to a complete stop for the final 1.5 seconds — a quiet lingering hold on her close-up.

PERFORMANCE
Photographic human realism indistinguishable from live-action footage: skin with visible pores, fine vellus hair catching the light, subsurface scattering in the earlobes and fingertips, capillary flush across her cheeks and ears, flyaway strands lifting off her hair, wet living eyes with true window catch-lights. Visible breathing at the collarbone, eyes darting a half-second before her head turns. Tension shown by muscle: shoulders drawn up, fingers clamped on the bag, jaw set, then a full-body shoulder drop on each escape. Dry clean skin, no sweat. All adults and students have equally real skin, real hair and natural asymmetric faces.

GAME-LIKE MOVEMENT
Her movement follows Metal Gear video-game logic, but it is filmed with fully realistic bodies, physics and real-time speed: walking past a teacher under stealth camouflage, a box that blends perfectly into a row of identical boxes, and a precise, gentle CQC takedown with a quick finger jab to the neck. The look stays live-action. It is not game CG.

PHYSICS
Her skirt pleats swing and settle with inertia on every stop; hair lags and sweeps across her face on turns. The chain-link fence rattles and flexes under her weight. The bag has real weight and bounces against her body. The cardboard box wobbles as it drops over her, then sits flat and still on the floor. The PRINCIPAL's body has believable weight as she lowers him, and his shoes squeak once on the linoleum. Contact shadows stay glued under every foot, knee and box corner.

LIGHTING
One continuous light logic: hard morning sun at 5600K, outdoors at the fence and through the window walls inside, throwing long window-frame stripes across the floors that NAGI passes through in light and shadow. The stealth camouflage refracts these stripes. Soft bounce fill off the pale linoleum lifts her face. In the classroom close-up the window light rakes softly across her cheek. Fine dust suspended in the sunbeams. Exposure rolls smoothly between bright and shadowed stretches.

AUDIO
(tense minimalist stealth synth loop with a pulsing heartbeat under it, rising whenever an adult nears NAGI, resolving to a short bright victory fanfare at the end) <chain-link fence rattle> <bamboo broom sweeping> <sneaker squeaks on linoleum> <soft electric shimmer as the camouflage switches on> <crackling flicker as it switches off> <slow footsteps> <cardboard rustle> <sharp alert sting> <quick soft thud of the finger jab> <shoe squeak on linoleum> <pencils scratching in notebooks> <distant volleyball whistle from the sports ground>. NAGI's apology to the PRINCIPAL is an inner-voice voiceover with her lips closed. All dialogue is spoken in Japanese.

STYLE
Photoreal live-action realism, real human beings and real fabric, natural skin tones with true-to-life color science, physically correct materials, realistic proportions, real optical depth of field, real floor reflections, subtle handheld gameplay motion blur, fine film grain at 5%, sharp detail.

POSITIVE LOCKS
One single continuous 30-second shot in strict real time, with no cuts, no transitions, no fast-forward and no speed changes. NAGI keeps the same face, long black hair with blunt bangs, white pink-striped sailor uniform, grey pleated skirt, black knee-highs and white sneakers throughout, with dry clean, tidy hair and skin. Her navy school bag is with her from the first frame to her desk. The stealth camouflage is used only to pass the CORRIDOR TEACHER, and there is no other game graphic. Under the box, NAGI's feet are never visible. The PE TEACHER is looking out the window while she hides and never finds her. The PRINCIPAL is thin, and he is knocked out by the finger jab to the neck. The corridor is short and straight with no stairs, and the classroom rear door is open. All students are girls in the same uniform with different hairstyles, facing the blackboard and taking notes. NAGI sits in the very last row, at the desk right inside the rear door, with only the back wall behind her. The video ends on a close-up of NAGI facing the blackboard and the teacher, seen from the front. Each adult appears only in their own section. Only one NAGI is on screen at any time. No HUD, no on-screen text and no subtitles anywhere. All spoken lines are in Japanese. Sunlight direction stays consistent for all 30 seconds.

entries.title: 酒吧走廊回眸人像
entries.note: 中文导演式提示词；需人物角色卡参考图（@图片1）。
entries.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 / 酒吧走廊回眸人像导演提示词
Duration：10秒
Aspect ratio：9:16 竖屏
Overall style：夜间酒吧实拍人像。背景保留深红和琥珀色，柔和的正面补光让眼神和唇角看得清楚。前段跟着人物走，后段用四次干净的硬切衔接姿势。表演幅度小，笑意逐镜增加。

SUBJECT / 角色与造型绑定
@图片1 命名为【女主】，全片面容和人物身份以角色卡为准。造型为浅金色及腰长卷发、轻薄齐刘海、粉色挂脖修身短裙、高跟鞋。裙子前胸中央有一道窄小开口，以金色小扣收住。双手空着。

ENVIRONMENT / 空间轴线
女主走在酒吧两排卡座之间的窄过道里。画面左侧是棕红软包靠背，右侧是深色桌面和几只玻璃杯。远处有人在卡座里交谈，保持虚焦。头顶一盏暖色水晶吊灯，红色灯带沿天花板折向纵深。暖光从侧后方照亮发梢，人物转正后，脸上有柔和补光。

AUDIO / 声音与节奏
使用鼓点清楚、低音轻快的原创律动配乐，切镜贴着鼓点。女主全程没有台词，嘴唇自然开合，不对口型。无旁白、无字幕。

SHOT 1（0.0–3.2秒）｜从背后跟她走进过道
Subject：女主。
Action：第一帧就已经在走。女主背对镜头，沿中央过道往前走，高跟鞋左右交替落地，步幅不大，落脚接近一条线。重心随每一步自然换边，两臂垂在身侧小幅前后摆。长卷发披在背上，发尾比肩膀慢半拍晃动。这三秒一直给完整背影。
Camera：背后全身跟拍（Rear full-body tracking shot）。镜头与她同速前移，头顶留出吊灯，画面下沿看见鞋跟，两侧卡座向后掠过。

SHOT 2（3.2–6.3秒）｜从发间露出侧脸，再接住镜头
Subject：女主。
Action：硬切到更近的背面构图。切入时女主双肘已经朝两侧打开，两手贴在后脑两侧。指尖顺着头发滑向后颈，她朝画面左侧转头，肩膀跟着转过小半圈。先露出鼻尖和侧脸，靠近镜头的手顺着颈侧经过下颌，再自然落向身侧。转身的惯性把长发带向画面右侧，发尾随后落回背上。
Performance：侧脸刚露出时目光还顺着转身方向走。等近侧肩膀停住，她才越过肩头直视镜头，下巴微收，嘴角轻轻提一点。留半拍给这个回眸。
Camera：背面中景转为侧后方回眸中景（Medium shot），从头顶拍到臀部。机位基本固定，由女主自己转出侧脸。

SHOT 3（6.3–7.4秒）｜正面拢发，向两侧松开
Subject：女主。
Action：硬切到正面腰上构图。切入时两手已经伸到后颈，双肘打开。她直视镜头，嘴唇自然微分，两手从头发底下向外托松，让卷发离开肩膀。画面右侧的一束发梢扬开时切镜。
Camera：正面腰上中景（Frontal medium shot）。脸居中，两侧留出手肘和发梢的空间。

SHOT 4（7.4–8.4秒）｜放宽景别，单手带出发束
Subject：女主。
Action：正面硬切到能看见裙摆和膝部的构图。女主一条腿轻轻交到另一条腿前，重心落在后腿。她用自己的右手，也就是画面左侧的手，松松捏着肩前一束长发往外带；另一只手自然垂在裙侧。目光仍迎着镜头，发尾在红色侧光里展开。
Camera：正面膝上中全景（Medium long shot）。保持机位稳定，让交叠的腿、裙摆和向外展开的发束在同一画面里看清。

SHOT 5（8.4–10.0秒）｜手从耳边落下，偏头笑
Subject：女主。
Action / Performance：切近，双手已经停在两耳旁，指尖轻轻碰着鬓发。她先看着镜头，松开发丝，双手沿身体两侧往下落。手落到腰前时，手腕放松，指尖自然靠近；同时把头轻轻偏向画面右侧，下巴略收。两边嘴角这时一起扬起来，眼睛随之略弯，形成全片最清楚的一次闭唇笑。最后留约半秒，眼神仍在镜头上，发梢自然落稳。
Camera：正面腰上中景（Medium shot）。脸、双肩和落到腰前的双手始终在画内，以微笑结束。

NEGATIVE / 全片负面约束
换脸，发长跳变，首镜提前回头，摄影机绕到正面，夸张扭胯，双手穿过头发或后颈，头发遮住回眸时的眼睛，全程咧嘴笑，慢动作甩头，闪白转场，背景人物抢镜，歌词字幕，水印。

entries.title: 带马桶的天价电竞椅动画
entries.prompt:
15-second horizontal 16:9 cinematic 3D animated comedy. Two adult characters, an extravagant gaming toilet-chair, a brief domestic conversation and a final price-tag reveal.

Natural movement, conversational English dialogue and tight comedic timing. No rushed speech, prolonged pauses, slow motion or speed ramps.

REFERENCES AND PRIORITY
Image 1 - MAN:
Use the supplied male character reference for his exact identity, face, heavyset body shape, balding crown, messy brown side hair, black rectangular glasses, facial stubble, blue polo shirt, brown trousers and dark sneakers.

Image 2 - WOMAN:
Use the supplied female character reference for her exact identity, face, curvy body shape, freckles, copper-red hair in a loose half-up bun, black glasses, hoop earrings, necklace, fitted red button-front top, ripped blue jeans with rolled cuffs and pale sneakers.

Image 3 - ROOM AND INITIAL CHAIR ORIENTATION:
Use the newest stylized 3D gaming-room image, where the chair is already shown FROM BEHIND and faces the television.
This reference defines the room layout, opening composition, lighting, furniture positions and the chair's orientation relative to the television.

Image 4 - CHAIR DESIGN:
Use the isolated chair on a neutral gray background with the raised overhead lamp.
This reference defines the chair's construction, leather panels, integrated toilet opening, footrest, base, controls, trays, water tank and tall lamp support.
Its frontal product-view camera angle does NOT define the video camera angle or the chair's orientation inside the room.
Do not copy its neutral background into the video.

Apply Image 4's chair design in Image 3's room and orientation. Image 3 determines where the chair faces. Image 4 supplies object details, not scene blocking.

The controller shown on the reference tray is already in the man's hands at the beginning of the video. Leave that tray empty. Add the physical price tag described below.

VISUAL STYLE
Match the polished cinematic 3D animation look of Image 3. Appealing rounded silhouettes, expressive eyes, sculpted faces and nuanced facial acting. Preserve the recognizable identities and body proportions of Images 1 and 2 while harmonizing them with the room's animation style.

Soft skin shading, subtle subsurface scattering, delicate freckles, carefully groomed hair, tactile leather, detailed fabric and convincing glass and metal.

Rich controlled colors, warm golden practical lights, cool blue gaming-room accents, soft global illumination and gentle depth of field.

Believable weight and restrained expressive exaggeration. No live-action characters mixed into an animated room. No studio names or studio logos.

INITIAL POSITION
From the FIRST FRAME, the man is already seated in the chair facing the television, exactly following the orientation shown in Image 3.

His chest, knees and the extended footrest point toward the television. The exterior rear surface of the backrest faces the opening camera.

The opening camera sees the back of the chair and the back of his head, with the television beyond him.

Do not animate a turn. Do not begin with the chair facing the camera. The chair remains stationary throughout the video.

CHARACTERS
MAN:
A heavyset middle-aged man with a round belly, broad cheeks, balding crown, messy brown side hair, black rectangular glasses and short facial stubble.

Preserve his blue polo, brown trousers and dark athletic shoes. His clothing folds naturally over his seated body, and the cushions compress under his weight.

He holds one white-and-black controller with both hands above his lap. His feet rest on the footrest. He is fully dressed and preparing to start the game.

Initially comfortable and pleased with the setup, he becomes sheepish when the woman mentions his paycheck. His smile fades, his eyebrows rise and he tries an unconvincing reassuring smile.

WOMAN:
Preserve the adult woman from Image 2, including her red hair, glasses, freckles, jewelry, red ribbed button-front top, ripped jeans and pale sneakers.

She enters with a practical question about their household money. Her tone is composed and expectant. His hesitation makes her mildly suspicious.

Natural gestures, no shouting or exaggerated anger.

ENVIRONMENT
Reproduce Image 3's stylized room: dark television wall, large screen, low black media cabinet, upright white console, soundbar, warmly illuminated collectible shelves, trailing plants, blue LED strips, wood flooring, plush gray rug, pale curtains and charcoal sofa.

Preserve the black door on the left wall. It opens into a softly lit hallway and stays clear of the woman's route.

The sofa's cushions are slightly compressed and worn, without changing its design or position.

The television retains the colorful GTA VI start-screen artwork visible in Image 3. The man is ready to start the game, not already playing active gameplay. The screen stays unchanged during the conversation.

CHAIR DETAILS
Use Image 4's black stitched leather chair, padded armrests, integrated toilet seat, extended footrest, circular blue-lit base, attached trays and transparent blue-lit water tank.

Preserve the tall curved support and raised warm circular lamp. Maintain generous clearance above the man's head. Do not lower the lamp or shorten its support.

All directions below refer to the seated man's perspective as he faces the television:

HIS LEFT:
Pizza tray with an open pizza box, soda holder, blue-lit water tank and toilet-paper roll.

HIS RIGHT:
The controller tray, empty because the controller is already in his hands.

In the opening rear view, his left-side accessories appear on the left side of the image, matching Image 3.

All accessories remain fixed to the chair. No eating, flushing, operating controls or moving trays.

BLOCKING
The woman enters through the left-wall door and follows the clear aisle outside the chair's left-side accessories.

She stops beside and slightly ahead of his left shoulder, approximately one meter away. She does not block the television, collide with the pizza tray or reach across the tank.

He looks at her with a natural leftward head turn and a small shoulder adjustment. His hips, legs and chair stay directed toward the television.

She remains there after stopping. The door stays ajar.

PRICE TAG
A cream-colored rectangular retail tag is physically attached by a short black cord to the outer front corner of his RIGHT armrest, below the empty controller tray.

The tag hangs against the dark leather, with its printed face pointing outward toward the chair's right side.

Print exactly:

1,999$

Large bold black text. Preserve the comma and trailing dollar sign. No additional digits, logos or fine print.

The tag exists from the beginning. Early framing keeps its printed face outside the crop, turned away or too small to read.

The final camera angle reveals the tag. Nobody picks it up or turns it toward the camera. It never appears spontaneously.

TIMELINE

00:00-00:02.00 | ESTABLISH THE SCENE
Begin with Image 3's rear room composition, now with the man seated in the chair.

Show the exterior backrest, the back of his head and the television directly in front of him. His seated body and footrest point toward the screen. The chair is stationary.

Use a slight rear three-quarter offset if needed to show a glimpse of his hands holding the controller while preserving the room layout.

The black door begins opening immediately. The woman appears and starts crossing the threshold before the shot ends.

Do not reveal the readable price tag.

00:02.00-00:07.00 | HER QUESTION
Cut to a medium front-left three-quarter view filmed from near the television, looking back toward the seated man.

The television is behind this camera and outside its frame. The camera position changes through a cut; the chair does not move.

Continue the woman's entrance without repeating it. She walks toward his left side while saying:

"Where's your paycheck? We need to buy a new sofa."

Clear, natural English delivery and accurate lip sync. She briefly gestures toward the sofa on "a new sofa."

She passes outside the pizza tray and tank, then stops beside and slightly ahead of his left shoulder.

Keep both characters readable. During her sentence, he turns his head toward her. His pleased expression fades at the mention of his paycheck.

His hands continue holding the controller. Let his reaction develop during her speech rather than adding a silent pause afterward.

00:07.00-00:10.00 | HIS ANSWER
Cut to a medium close-up of the man, matching his eyeline toward the woman at his left.

He gives a sheepish half-smile and says:

"Well... there's a tiny problem."

Use a brief hesitation after "Well," then natural conversational pacing. Emphasize "tiny" with a small apologetic shoulder lift.

Both hands remain on the controller. His body stays seated toward the television.

As the line ends, his eyes briefly dip toward the right armrest. Cut directly to the reveal, without an additional reaction shot.

00:10.00-00:12.00 | FIND THE PRICE
Cut to a medium detail view from the man's RIGHT side.

Establish the right armrest, empty controller tray, part of his blue sleeve and the controller still held above his lap.

The camera makes a short downward move and smooth push-in toward the tag below the tray. Shift focus onto its printed face.

The camera angle reveals the existing tag; the tag does not turn itself.

By 00:12.00, the complete price is large and sharp:

1,999$

00:12.00-00:15.00 | THE PUNCHLINE
Hold a clean close-up of the physical price tag.

The entire price remains sharp, stable and inside the frame. Show the black cord and part of the stitched leather armrest so the price clearly belongs to the chair.

Use a very subtle continuing camera push and quiet room ambience.

No further dialogue, reaction cut, animated text or added joke. End on the price.

CAMERA AND EDITING
Image 3 establishes the opening view and correct chair orientation.

After the opening, frontal shots are filmed from the television side, looking back toward the man. The television is behind the camera, never incorrectly behind his head in these shots.

Maintain consistent room geography and matching eyelines. The man looks at the woman, and she looks at him.

The final right-side angle is introduced by a clean cut. No camera passing through furniture or characters.

Keep the price unreadable until the reveal. No early close-up or accidental readable view.

Natural motion, controlled framing and expressive facial acting. No unnecessary orbiting, repeated reactions or artificial acceleration.

AUDIO
All dialogue is in English, spoken once with accurate lip sync.

Woman:
"Where's your paycheck? We need to buy a new sofa."

Man:
"Well... there's a tiny problem."

Her voice is practical and expectant. His voice is warm, embarrassed and hesitant.

Natural door latch, hinge movement, footsteps, clothing movement, soft leather creaks and quiet room ambience.

No active gameplay sounds over the static start screen. No toilet flush.

No background music, narrator, canned laughter, subtitles or extra lines.

CONTINUITY AND CONSTRAINTS
Exactly 15 seconds.

Image 1 controls the man's identity and clothes.
Image 2 controls the woman's identity and clothes.
Image 3 controls the room, opening composition, animation style and chair orientation.
Image 4 controls the chair's detailed construction and raised lamp.

The isolated chair's frontal product view must never override its television-facing position in the room.

The man is already seated facing the television from the first frame. No chair rotation or moving television.

The woman enters once, walks to his left side and stops. The door remains ajar.

One controller only, held in both hands throughout. Its tray stays empty despite the controller appearing there in the object references.

All accessories remain attached. Keep adequate clearance between the man's head and the raised lamp.

One price tag and one cord, fixed to the right armrest. Exact text: "1,999$". No floating price graphic or changing digits.

No extra fingers, intersecting limbs, floating props, disappearing accessories or inconsistent character designs.

Sequence: man already facing the television, her entrance and question, his guilty answer, camera reveal of the attached price tag.
